action: Formalized referral arrangement with Tamika Jefferson; drafted first Wright Workforce Advisory LLC case study; opened post-program consulting conversation with Patricia Hawkins; scheduled informational call with healthcare HR contact
narrative: The 30-minute call with Tamika Jefferson went well — they formalized a mutual referral arrangement and Tamika enthusiastically agreed to be a case study subject, giving Angela permission to document her freelance pivot story as a proof-of-concept narrative for Wright Workforce Advisory LLC. Angela drafted a two-page case study this tick based on the displacement intake work from tick 9, anonymizing the sales floor workers she routed to community college and the Maria Santos grant pathway; the document is rough but it is real, and it is the first portfolio artifact the consulting entity has ever had. The conversation with Patricia Hawkins was the most significant development: Patricia did not wait for the post-program question to be framed as hypothetical — she acknowledged directly that when the current transition program winds down, Regional Auto Group will likely need ongoing support that looks more like consulting than internal HR, and she said Angela's name specifically when she said it. No formal offer, no dollar figures, but the signal was unambiguous. Angela's LinkedIn contact in healthcare administration at a regional hospital group agreed to a 20-minute informational call for next week.
